title: Emberveil Enemies / Bosses File (v1)
description: Canonical enemy (and boss) stat blocks keyed by id. Covers ENEMIES, ENEMIES_ACT4, ENEMIES_ACT5, ENEMIES_ACT6 from mapData.js, plus inline encounter enemies that had no base dict entry (giant_spider, the inline dragon/void roster), and hidden-boss creatures. Used for both enemies.json and bosses.json.
